name: Pearl -Xiangfeng zai Qiuri-
source:
While attending university, Alvin returned to Shinguang City, where he spent his childhood.
There, he encountered a girl who seemed oddly familiar.
Where exactly had they met before?
Alvin couldn't recall at the moment, but even so, he wanted to get closer to her.
Unexpectedly, both she and he were connected to magic.
